title: First prompt after accepting trust can go out without SessionStart context
observed: After the trust dialog was accepted, internal/cli/tui.go ran the deferred SessionStart hooks on a goroutine of their own and sent their output later as MsgStartupContext. A prompt submitted before that message landed went out without the hook context; test/e2e/trust_test.go hid it with a 500ms sleep.
expected: The prompt waits for the SessionStart hooks (busy line 'Running session start hooks', the prompt queued) and goes out with their context, as Claude Code's submit path awaits awaitSessionStartHooks. Esc stops the wait, not the hooks, and puts the queued prompt back in the input; their output is kept for the next prompt.
evidence: TestTUI_Trust_HooksAndAllowWaitForTrust with a 1s SessionStart hook fails on the old code: 'the first prompt lacks the SessionStart context'.
TestTrustedSessionStart_PromptWaitsForContext fails without the background operation; TestTrustedSessionStart_EscStopsTheWaitNotTheHooks and _PromptAfterEscWaitsAgain cover Esc.
